title: Independent fractional image-mask weight representation and numeric getter

entry_inventory.meaning: Entry registration only; not full parameter/default/numerical/backend coverage

implementation: Keep scientific Pixel values and independent fractional weights in immutable with_mask IR; never multiply weights into science values.

Official updateMask single-band broadcast or equal-count positional masks, finite[0,1] validation, separate source validity/new mask NoData, documented replacement-at-nonzero-old-mask local interpretation.
mask() omitted/null getters produce ordinary Float64 weight bands; valid zero at NoData, original band names/properties/grid retained. Selection, rename and addBands preserve the carrier.

Closed top-level local_ee_mask_weights validity/update/apply process with Python/Scala canonical parsers, strict input arities, trusted SPI provider and67108864 work cap plus unchanged existing limits.
Mapped mask getters frame actual immutable observations before upstream same-day coalescing; grid/time proof remains fresh and constants bind only to actual finite grids.
Explicit Float64 projection boundary preserves prior explicit Float32/arithmetic stages. This is hardening, not a reproduced temporal-first precision bug.
A source-free masked null used as a raster mask operand binds as actual NoData on the other operand grid, never a fabricated zero scientific value.
Dry-run handler records a real process boundary and blocks output band pushdown to source operands; real pinned evaluator tested.

Builder works as imported Python package and direct CLI; standalone explicit classpath mode never reads native deployment configs and emits non-deployable audit manifest with source/helper/tool/runtime hashes.
Python example68, JavaScript example22, local web syntax reference and architecture/engineering guidance updated.

native_tile_probe.scope: Actual GeoTrellis DoubleArrayTile inputs through LocalEeMaskWeightsNumeric.applyTile; no SparkContext, service, sandbox task, VM, container, or private raster data.

independent_review.scope: Scoped carrier/getter/grid/time/NoData/budget correctness review, not repository-wide security audit

failures_preserved: First full run:16 collection errors from standalone builder helper bare import; package/direct-script import fixed and two clean subprocess regressions added.
Second full run:6255 passed and one old lowercase fractional-message regex failure; original test preserved unchanged, error wording clarified. Final full run passed.
Same-day multi-observation direct mask projection identity gap fixed via per-item framing and all timed inputs checked.
Nested masked-constant NoData binding rejection fixed without converting missing raw data to zero.
Initial temporal-first narrowing hypothesis withdrawn after pinned JVM bytecode showed preserve-datatype first behavior; no observed numeric failure claimed.
Concurrent SDK fixture synchronization and independent reference missing NaN-to-zero assignment were test-harness issues, corrected without changing the intended fixture contract.
limits_and_unverified: Default spherical fractional clip, Point/Line clip and clipToCollection remain unimplemented; planar center masks are not a replacement.

Weighted science-value arithmetic, reductions, visualization alpha and artifact weight encoding are not enabled consumers; unsupported carrier compilation rejects. Numeric mask() images are ordinary data views.
Fractional updateMask composition follows an explicit reading of official documentation; exact Google behavior/precision is unverified.
No full Spark batch, service/browser/native deployment or private real-data acceptance. No Google EE runtime/auth/quota request.
Audit JAR is not deployment eligible and was not installed. Existing dependency bytes were recorded, not fully publicly attested; do not infer production provenance or vulnerability absence.
Prior S2 strict binary64 incidence/roundtrip differences, mixed-model transforms, projection/measurement and work-budget gaps remain unchanged.
Full production-oriented goal remains active; this batch provides a weight carrier and getter foundation, not full GEE mask compatibility.
